title: Sales & CS launch rapid-response playset
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Create a compact, high-velocity enablement bundle for Sales and Customer Success to support the console-2025.03 release. Bundle emphasizes rapid response assets for last-minute demos, release-note callouts, objection handling, and an escalation matrix so CS can move from awareness to resolution quickly.
deliverables: 5-minute live-demo script with exact prompts and feature toggles
Release notes quick-reference card mapped to buyer personas
Escalation matrix + Slack triage snippets for CS
Localized FAQ (EN/FR/DE) for common merchant questions
Recordable 10-minute enablement video for seller onboarding
comments: 2025-02-14 Sofia M: Kickoff met with Sales ops and CS leads. Agreed top 3 buyer personas and final demo flow. Action: design to ship one-pager draft by 2025-02-18.
2025-02-18 Asha P (Design): First one-pager mock uploaded to Drive. Requested copy edit — tightened pitch from 90s to 30s. Attached version v1.1.
2025-02-19 Liam G: Review with Sales SDR leads. Feedback: need explicit objection response for 'cost per token' and 'model compatibility'. Adding two quick benchmark lines for latency/cost.

2025-02-21 Ravi S (Eng): Demo script validated against staging environment. Note: model fallback flow uses model-variant v2-beta and requires flag enablement ENG-3189; scheduled to be toggled by 2025-02-25.
2025-02-23 Sofia M: Draft Release Notes quick-reference mapped to persona-created. Requested translation for FR/DE; assigned to localization queue.

2025-02-25 Liam G: CS triage snippets reviewed with Support leads. Added Slack escalation snippet for P1 performance regressions pointing to runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/kv-cache-incident-runbook
2025-02-27 Asha P: Recorded 6-min trimmed enablement video; editing in progress. ETA final cut 2025-03-02.

2025-02-28 Liam G: Pulled together demo checklist and rehearsal schedule. Two live sales rehearsals booked (2025-03-03, 2025-03-04). Need final sign-off on one-pager and release-note card by 2025-03-01.
notes: Trade-offs: kept one-pager intentionally concise to favor speed-of-use in sales calls; deeper technical docs will live in Confluence. We decided against including full benchmark tables to avoid outdated numbers in fast-moving infra; instead we link to the live latency/cost dashboard. Cross-team coordination required: Eng must flip feature flag for demo fallback (ENG-3189) and Docs must merge release-note PR before enablement distribution. Post-launch follow-up: collect 10 sales feedback forms and 3 CS triage logs to measure usefulness and iterate.
